photorealistic.label: photorealistic
photorealistic.medium: Still photograph from a real camera, captured in the moment.
photorealistic.light: Physically plausible key and fill with true contact shadows and natural falloff.
photorealistic.color: Honest scene color with a mild photographic grade.
photorealistic.texture: Skin pores, fabric weave, material microdetail, mild grain.
photorealistic.camera: Real lens compression and plausible depth of field.
photorealistic.suffix: Photoreal photograph, natural materials, physically plausible light.

cinematic_film_still.label: cinematic film still
cinematic_film_still.light: Motivated practicals, cinematic contrast, rim from visible lamps.
cinematic_film_still.camera: Widescreen anamorphic-adjacent framing with oval highlights.
cinematic_film_still.suffix: Cinematic feature-film still, widescreen, motivated practicals.

analog_35mm_film.label: analog 35mm film
analog_35mm_film.light: Photographic exposure with mild highlight roll-off.
analog_35mm_film.texture: Fine film grain, slight halation, mild gate weave.
analog_35mm_film.camera: Spherical still-camera lens with photographic depth of field.
analog_35mm_film.suffix: Analog 35mm color-negative film grain and organic color.

analog_120_medium_format.label: analog 120 medium format
analog_120_medium_format.light: Soft modeled light on a shallow plane of focus.
analog_120_medium_format.texture: Fine grain with high resolving power.
analog_120_medium_format.suffix: Medium-format 120 film, creamy tones, fine grain.

polaroid_instant.label: Polaroid instant
polaroid_instant.color: Slight color shift typical of instant dye.
polaroid_instant.camera: White frame implied by the print look, empty of burned-in letters.
polaroid_instant.suffix: Instant Polaroid print look, soft contrast, creamy highlights.

golden_hour_photography.label: golden-hour photography
golden_hour_photography.light: Long warm sidelight, amber rim, long shadows, clear air.
golden_hour_photography.camera: Real still lens, plausible depth of field.
golden_hour_photography.suffix: Golden-hour photograph, warm sidelight, long shadows.

overcast_natural_light.label: overcast natural light
overcast_natural_light.light: Soft sky-fill, gentle falloff, open shadows.
overcast_natural_light.texture: Even material detail without hard speculars.
overcast_natural_light.suffix: Overcast natural light, soft sky-fill, open shadows.

studio_product_photography.label: studio product photography
studio_product_photography.medium: Catalog still on a seamless cyclorama.
studio_product_photography.light: Large soft key, controlled speculars, clean contact shadow.
studio_product_photography.suffix: Studio product photograph, seamless backdrop, soft key.

editorial_fashion_photography.label: editorial fashion photography
editorial_fashion_photography.camera: Stylized posing, precise styling, fashion framing.
editorial_fashion_photography.suffix: Editorial fashion photograph, precise styling, magazine light.

street_photography.label: street photography
street_photography.suffix: Candid street photograph, mixed city light, layered depth.

architectural_photography.label: architectural photography
architectural_photography.camera: Corrected verticals. People only when the source asked for them.
architectural_photography.suffix: Architectural photograph, corrected verticals, material texture.

anime.label: anime
anime.medium: Japanese anime still with clean cel color and sharp line.

cartoon.label: cartoon
cartoon.suffix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick outline, flat color.
